rules.description: Reactive Intervention handlers / meta-tools must stay listed in CAPABILITIES.md (see also scripts/check-capabilities.ts for the handler-registry side of this check).
A new dated CHANGELOG.md version header needs a matching section in the Starlight What's New page. Only fires on an actual `## [X.Y.Z]` header, not on routine commits landing under `## [Unreleased]`.
Builder surface changes need README.md and the Starlight builder-api reference kept truthful.
